data.description:
## Description

What: New plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry-adapters/bot-comment-scan.sh that reads PR review comments and issue comments via gh api, applies (reviewer_id, github_comment_id) dedup with append-only state in ${ARTIFACTS_DIR}/bot-comment-seen.log seeded from the central S3 telemetry (commit_sha-partitioned glob) on fresh CI runs, performs the cross-epic readiness check (telemetry-emit.sh on PATH + endpoint config set, else single CI_WARNING to stderr and exit 0), and consumes the pr_comments.bot_authors allowlist with case-insensitive matching and empty-string fail-fast. Why: bot findings need durable telemetry and must not be double-counted. Scope IN: the adapter, base dedup + S3 seed, readiness check, allowlist config knob (default coderabbitai,gitar-bot,Copilot) with empty-string ERROR fail-fast and case-insensitive matching, non-allowlisted user.type==Bot skip with no author_class and no telemetry. Scope OUT: per-bot parser body logic (draft-3); the repeated-failure escalation counter (draft-6); thread resolution.


## Done Definitions

- Running bot-comment-scan.sh against a PR with N distinct bot comments emits exactly N telemetry events; re-running across a second push ingests zero duplicates (dedup keyed on (reviewer_id, github_comment_id), state in append-only bot-comment-seen.log seeded from the commit_sha-partitioned S3 glob) ← Satisfies: sc-5
- pr_comments.bot_authors='' causes the adapter to exit non-zero at startup with ERROR: pr_comments.bot_authors is empty; an uppercase-login bot fixture matches a lowercase allowlist entry; a non-allowlisted dependabot fixture (user.type=='Bot') is skipped with no author_class and no telemetry event ← Satisfies: sc-7
- When telemetry-emit.sh is absent from PATH or the endpoint config is unset, the adapter emits exactly one CI_WARNING to stderr and exits 0 (graceful, not silent) ← Satisfies: sc-1
- Each ingested allowlisted comment produces a telemetry event whose tool_id is the correct reviewer_id (coderabbit | gitar | copilot) ← Satisfies: sc-1

## Considerations

- [Cross-epic-invariant] The S3 seed glob MUST target only the current commit_sha partition (<client_id>/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<commit_sha>/*) per the coordinated key design with d2f9-ee1a-48ab-4bf6; do not glob the whole bucket.
- [Reliability] Readiness check failure must surface in CI logs (CI_WARNING), never a silent skip.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a pipeline maintainer, I want a per-push bot-comment-scan adapter that ingests CodeRabbit/Gitar/Copilot comments exactly once and records them as telemetry, so that bot findings are captured without re-ingesting duplicates across pushes.
